classification.difficultyReason: Five direct applications of the quotient rule to linear-over-linear functions. The method is named, but u and v are not supplied, so the student must pick them, differentiate (both derivatives are 1) and substitute. The only simplification is a numerator that collapses to a constant, with attention to sign in parts a and c. Nothing needs reframing or interpreting, and the five parts repeat the same skill with changed signs. This is slightly above p51-q1 (18), which supplies u, v and their derivatives, and below A3 (30), which needs a representation change to an algebraic fraction.
